page.heading: Currency, locale & timezone
page.description: The currency, locale and timezone options tenants can choose from. Deactivate an option to hide it from new selections without breaking companies already using it.

empty.title: No options yet
empty.description: Add one so it appears in the company currency/locale/timezone pickers.

form.description: The code is what's stored on a company and used to format its money and dates — it must be a real value the browser recognises.

delete.title: Delete this option?
delete.body: It disappears from every picker. Refused if a company is currently using it — deactivate it instead.

toasts.deleteError: Could not delete the option — it may still be in use
